headline: 5 Facts: Prabowo Steps In to Tackle Power Outages; Fuel Also in Spotlight | Okezone Economy
summary: Indonesian President Prabowo instructed the energy ministry and state utility PT PLN Persero to take immediate measured steps on power outages, with fuel also in focus.
why: PLN is Indonesia's state electricity utility, and power outages and fuel supply affect industrial output and energy costs across the country.
